achievements.name: Prologue
achievements.detail: Finish the prologue and fight with Emblem Marth.

achievements.name: Engage Attack
achievements.detail: Engage a unit with an Emblem and use an Engage attack in battle.

achievements.name: Twelve Rings
achievements.detail: Obtain all twelve Emblem Rings over the course of the main story.

achievements.name: All Paralogues
achievements.detail: Clear every paralogue that belongs to the twelve main Emblems.

achievements.name: Master Seal
achievements.detail: Promote a unit to an advanced class with a Master Seal.

achievements.name: Pact Ring
achievements.detail: Give the Pact Ring to an ally.

achievements.name: Highest Bond
achievements.detail: Raise one Emblem's bond rank as high as it can go.

achievements.name: Inherited Skill
achievements.detail: Spend SP to inherit a skill from an Emblem onto a unit.

achievements.name: Four Nations
achievements.detail: Recruit allies from Firene, Brodia, Elusia, and Solm.

achievements.name: Somniel Arena
achievements.detail: Win a battle in the arena on the Somniel.

achievements.name: Main Campaign
achievements.detail: Clear the final chapter of the main story.

achievements.name: Maddening Clear
achievements.detail: Finish the main story on Maddening difficulty.

achievements.name: Fell Xenologue
achievements.detail: Clear the separate Xenologue campaign through its last chapter.
